Who can manage Google reviews for my apartment property?

Short answer

An apartment marketing agency or reputation service can reply to your Google reviews for you. The SocialDM replies to Google reviews for apartment communities in Arizona, Nevada, Florida and Oregon, so reviews get answered in the property's own voice.

The SocialDM · Nov 11, 2026
The problem

What a good reply does

01Thanks the reviewer for something specific they said.
02Acknowledges the concern without arguing, and moves the details to a private conversation.
03Never shares personal details, and never mentions family status, disability, religion or any other protected trait.
04Sounds like your team, not a copy and paste line.
Why replies matterRenters read the replies, not just the stars. A calm, specific answer to a bad review can do more for the next renter than the review did harm. AI tools also read reviews when they describe a community.
What to ask any providerWho writes the replies, and how do they learn your community's voice? What happens with a negative or fake review? Do you also manage the rest of the Google Business Profile?

Related: Google Business Profile management for apartments

FAQ

Questions we hear

Can you remove bad reviews?

Only Google or the reviewer can remove a review, and Google removes only those that break its policies. We flag those through Google's process.

Whose name do replies post under?

Your property's Google Business Profile, the same as if your team wrote them.
